top_signals.title: New Android malware encrypts files, steals data, and harasses victims
top_signals.summary: A new Android malware strain called Mantax Otax combines ransomware and spyware capabilities to encrypt files, steal sensitive data, and spam and harass victims. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oracle's stock edges up on earnings beat as cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubles
top_signals.summary: Oracle's results for the quarter came in stronger than expected, as did its revenue backlog.
